title: Face Recognition System
tagline: A face scan instead of a password or a card.

meta.title: Face Recognition System | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: A face scan instead of a password or a card.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Passwords and ID cards are vulnerable to fraud and loss, and checking them is friction every single person has to go through.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: Deep learning-trained facial recognition verifies identity from a live scan, adding a security layer that's difficult to replicate.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Faster, more secure authentication with less reliance on things people can lose or share.
